name: portfolio
description: Brandon Martins — personal portfolio (client + server + shared package)
author: Brandon Martins

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @portfolio/shared && concurrently -n shared,client,server -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @portfolio/shared" "npm run dev -w client --ignore-scripts" "npm run dev -w server --ignore-scripts"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/shared && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @portfolio/shared && npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server
